_comment: Hand-reviewed decisions applied after the keyword screen. Every rule needs exhibit, pe_or_bli and reason; 'account' (appropriation code) is optional and narrows the rule. 'include' adds a line no keyword caught; 'exclude' drops a false hit. Excluded lines are listed in data/lines.json under 'excluded' so nothing disappears silently.

include.reason: Launched Effects are air-launched small UAS; matches R-1 PEs 0602345A/0603345A/0609345A, which are titled 'Unmanned Aerial Systems Launched Effects'.
Title 'Family of Low Altitude Unmanned Systems' names low-altitude (air) unmanned systems. Not yet checked against the P-40 narrative.
Unmanned Carrier Aviation (UCA) is the carrier-based unmanned aircraft program (MQ-25 RDT&E); the MQ-25 P-1 line is already a keyword hit.
Autonomous Collaborative Platforms are uncrewed aircraft in the same family as the CCA lines already kept.
SOCOM 'Unmanned ISR'. Treated as aerial UAS from the title alone. Not yet checked against the J-book; it may include non-air systems.
SOCOM 'Unmanned ISR' RDT&E, the counterpart of P-1 0201UMNISR. Same caveat: from the title only.

exclude.reason: 'Target Drones' are aerial targets for test and training, not operational UAS. Excluded for consistency with the 'Aerial Targets' lines (Navy P-1 2280, AF R-1 0305116F), which also aren't counted.

reviewed: 2026-11-11, FY2026 P-1/R-1, from titles only (J-book narratives not yet read). Every kept keyword hit was read; misses were looked for with a broader term scan (unmanned, autonomous, launched effects, counter-, air defense, directed energy, targets, robotics).

related_not_counted._comment: Lines with a real but unknown UAS/C-UAS share. extract.py reads their amounts into data/lines.json under related_not_counted, but they are in no total. Each needs a group and a reason. The R-2/P-40 J-book documents listed in the README ('PDFs needed') would let slice 3 move a firm share into the counted lines.

lines.reason: Army mobile short-range air defence for manoeuvre units. It is built to defeat drones as well as helicopters and fixed-wing aircraft; the P-1 does not split the share.
RDT&E counterpart of the M-SHORAD procurement line. Same mixed mission; the R-1 gives one figure.
Marine Corps Ground Based Air Defense, the line that buys MADIS counter-drone systems alongside other air-defence equipment. One figure for the whole line.
Marine Corps air-defence weapons RDT&E. The title does not say how much is counter-drone work.
Air Force airbase air-defence systems. Drones are one threat among several; the share is not in the exhibit.
Army Future Interceptor. The title does not say which air threats it targets.
Directed-energy weapons can engage drones, but this line also covers other targets and general laser/microwave technology. The exhibit gives one figure.
